sections.title: What it is
sections.body: Action rolls intended to inflict harm with a weapon, spell, or unarmed strike.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Use when a PC attacks an adversary or a feature calls for an attack roll.

sections.title: Step by step
items: Use when a PC attacks an adversary or a feature calls for an attack roll.
Make the relevant action roll against the target Difficulty, then roll damage on a success.
Return to the fiction with the concrete result, cost, or benefit.
